Short title: Management of breast cancer for women aged 70+ in Greater Manchester
Long title: Management of breast cancer for women aged 70+ in Greater Manchester: the role of patient choice in the surgical treatment decision

The primary aim is to investigate the role of patient choice, from the perspectives of both patients and surgeons, in the surgical treatment decision for older women with breast cancer (controlling for tumour characteristics and health).
The secondary aim is to determine which health measures best predict post surgical outcomes.

Data access is restricted to those named in section 7 of this agreement. Any changes will be notified to the NHS IC.
